subtopic: Magnetic Force on a Moving Charge
stem: A proton enters a perpendicular uniform magnetic field \(B\) at origin along the positive \(x\) axis with a velocity v as shown in the figure. Then it will follow the following path. [The magnetic field is directed into the paper].

options.label: A
options.text: It will continue to move along positive \(x\) axis.

options.label: B
options.text: It will move along a curved path, bending towards positive \(x\) axis.

options.label: C
options.text: It will move along a curved path, bending towards negative \(y\) axis.

options.label: D
options.text: It will move along a sinusoidal path along the positive \(x\) axis.

solution: [Textbook misprint: option (B) is printed as "It will move along a curved path, bending towards positive \(x\) axis". As printed, no option is correct — a particle already travelling along the positive \(x\) axis cannot bend towards it — while the derivation above gives a deflection towards the positive \(y\) axis. Read alongside option (C), which names the negative \(y\) axis, option (B) is a misprint for "positive \(y\) axis", and it is keyed here on that reading. The book prints no MCQ key anywhere, so this is an adjudication of the printed options rather than a disagreement with a printed key.]
